title: GTA 6 $400 Collector's Set Does Not Include the Game
description: GTA 6 is set to release a $400 collector's set filled with Vice City-themed goodies, but surprisingly, it does not include a copy of the game.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Gets a $400 Collector's Set That Leaves Out the Game

As anticipation for Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster reaches an all-time high, new merchandise details have surfaced to capture the attention of hardcore fans. According to a recent report by IGN Games, GTA 6 is set to receive a massive $400 collector's set packed with Vice City-themed goodies. However, there is a major catch that has quickly become a talking point in the gaming community: the expensive bundle does not include a copy of the game itself.

### What to Expect from the $400 Vice City Bundle

For collectors who can't get enough of the neon-soaked aesthetics of Vice City, this premium set promises an array of themed memorabilia and items designed to celebrate the setting of the new title. The collection is entirely curated around physical goodies, leaning heavily into the iconic atmosphere that fans have been waiting to return to for over a decade.

Despite the exciting lineup of items, the absence of the game software means that purchasers will need to acquire their copy of GTA 6 separately, whether through digital storefronts or standard physical retail editions.

### Industry Trends and Community Perspective

This is not the first time the gaming industry has seen high-end collector's editions or merchandise bundles separated from the actual software. While this strategy offers flexibility for players who prefer digital versions or specific platforms, it also pushes the total investment much higher for those who want both the physical collectibles and the game on day one. Analysis of similar industry releases suggests this approach caters strictly to dedicated merchandise collectors rather than the average consumer looking for a complete launch package.

## Editor's Take

Charging $400 for a collector's set without even including the game is a bold move. While GTA 6 brand power is undeniably massive, asking fans to pay a premium price for just the swag might test even the most dedicated collectors. Make sure to check the value of the physical goodies before opening your wallet.
